admission.justification: The response, source adapters, route-specific confinement and client selectors jointly prevent arbitrary Git arguments or out-of-scope media reads while serving bounded selected content.

applicability: Media byte sources and responses for allowed working files, selected change-set sides and the knowledge reader's selected code source.
conditions: Route-specific selection and confinement admit the source before its media bytes are returned.
Change-set callers supply existing selectors and side names; the server resolves the revision.
The knowledge reader retains its separate selected-memory-commit contract and derives the code blob from that selection.
The shared 16 MiB source bound and fixed served-type table apply.
No-store, nosniff and inert SVG content-security headers describe successful full or partial media responses.
exclusions: Text-route size policy and the separate missing text-diff limit.

evidence: Curator source inspection of exact code tree96bf73439f79ee12d2529b31a1d94866756c0c1c; these integration and wire declarations realize the existing requirement obligation, with no test execution claimed.

statement: Media reads use confined paths and fixed types, validate server-resolved change-set sides before Git access, enforce the named byte bound, answer byte ranges, and return no-store responses with an inert SVG policy.
